title: House and Visitor
author: Emrys Fairweather
blurb: Jude Vane, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the last resident signs the papers.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
